deviations: CLAUDE.md section 1 specifies Python 3.11; this build runs Python 3.12 because 3.11 is not installed on the examination workstation and every pinned dependency publishes 3.12 wheels.

torch is installed from the CPU wheel index on the examination workstation, which has no CUDA device. Model training was performed on a separate CUDA 12.8 workstation; checkpoint SHA-256 values are recorded in the examination manifest.
